calibration.adverse_definition: fit failure OR fitting warning OR absolute one-step standardized residual > 2.576

health_nu_min_not_applicable_reason: Current runtime uses signal variance, not nu, for prescribed noise.
limitations: Probe points are archived feasible designs, not the exact runtime restart pools.
The selected variance is held fixed on the standardized scale by converting it separately at each fit.
Recommendations require engineering review before becoming package defaults.
